title: Node.js Express Server Health & MongoDB State (/api/health)
purpose: Live Express server health check and MongoDB connectivity verification.
what_it_demonstrates: Express.js REST API running on port 5003 with JSON response verifying active server status and live MongoDB connection.

title: Mongoose Books REST API Endpoint (GET /api/books)
purpose: Live JSON payload returned by Mongoose Book.find() query.
what_it_demonstrates: Express REST endpoint returning 77 book documents serialized from MongoDB with Mongoose Schema fields, text search indexing, and inventory counts.

title: Main Kitab Ghar SPA Connected to Express Backend & MongoDB
purpose: Real Kitab Ghar homepage rendering dynamic data supplied by Express & MongoDB.
what_it_demonstrates: Client layout, official branding logo, Book Genie reading guide, and featured live book catalogue fetched asynchronously from the Express API.

title: Live Books Catalogue Route (/books) Querying MongoDB
purpose: Live React frontend catalogue rendering 77 books directly from MongoDB.
what_it_demonstrates: React SPA fetching the live 77-book catalogue from the Express /api/books endpoint, with live search and category filtering executing against MongoDB.

title: Dynamic Book Details (/books/:id) using Mongoose findById
purpose: Real book detail view fetched via GET /api/books/:id.
what_it_demonstrates: Dynamic book record loaded from MongoDB via Mongoose findById(), rendering title, author, description, category, and real-time copy availability.

title: Reader Membership Plans (/membership) via Mongoose Plans Collection
purpose: Live subscription tiers loaded from MongoDB /api/plans.
what_it_demonstrates: Dynamic membership options (Basic, Standard, Bibliophile) rendered from MongoDB documents via Express, with interactive UPI payment trigger.

title: User Authentication & JWT Token Exchange (/login)
what_it_demonstrates: Reader login form sending credentials to Express authController, verifying hashed passwords with bcrypt in MongoDB and returning signed JWT session tokens.

title: Protected Reader Dashboard (/dashboard) Querying User State
purpose: Authenticated dashboard populated from MongoDB via JWT protected routes.
what_it_demonstrates: Protected reader dashboard rendering verified user account details, rental summary, and active subscriptions guarded by Express JWT middleware.
